name: EVENTS-001-F07 Keep event time meaning across zones and clock changes

background.text: the phone time zone is Europe/Paris
the phone language is English United States

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S32 Convert display without changing the editing zone

steps.text: Dentist starts at 09:00 on 2027-01-15 with description Checkup
the owner changes the phone time zone to <display_zone>
Dentist is represented at <display_time> on <display_date>
the owner opens Dentist for editing
the editing date and hour are 2027-01-15 and 09:00
the editing zone is identified as Europe/Paris
the owner abandons the editor
Dentist is represented at <display_time> on <display_date>

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S33 Keep the origin clock time when DST offsets change

steps.text: Course starts at 09:00 on 2027-03-21 every 1 weeks ending after 3 occurrences
the owner changes the phone time zone to America/New_York
Course is represented at 04:00 on 2027-03-21
Course is represented at 03:00 on 2027-03-28 and 2027-04-04
the owner inspects each occurrence for editing without saving
each occurrence still requests 09:00 in Europe/Paris
each computed duration is 60 elapsed minutes

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S34 All-day dates do not shift with the display zone

steps.text: Picnic is all-day on 2027-01-15 with description Outside
the owner changes the phone time zone to <display_zone>
Picnic is all-day on 2027-01-15
Picnic is not represented on 2027-01-14 or 2027-01-16

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S35 Adding an hour to an all-day event captures the current phone zone

steps.text: Picnic is all-day on 2027-01-15 with description Outside
the owner changes the phone time zone to Asia/Tokyo
the owner edits Picnic to timed at 09:00 on 2027-01-15 and saves
the owner opens Picnic for editing
the editing zone is identified as Asia/Tokyo
the owner abandons the editor
the owner changes the phone time zone to UTC
Picnic is represented at 00:00 on 2027-01-15
exactly 1 event named Picnic exists

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S36 Shift a nonexistent hour without drifting the recurrence clock

steps.text: the owner opened event creation with + for Course from 2027-03-28
the owner selects daily recurrence at 02:30 ending after 2 occurrences
the editor shows that the first start is adjusted to 03:30 in Europe/Paris
the requested recurrence clock remains 02:30
the owner saves Course
the computed interval is 2027-03-28 03:30 to 2027-03-28 04:30 in Europe/Paris
the next occurrence is 2027-03-29 02:30 to 2027-03-29 03:30 in Europe/Paris
the owner changes the phone time zone to UTC
Course starts at 01:30 on 2027-03-28 and at 00:30 on 2027-03-29
exactly 2 Course starts exist from 2027-03-28 through 2027-03-30

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S37 Choose the first repeated local hour only once

steps.text: the owner creates Night with + at 02:30 on 2026-10-25 without a description
exactly 1 Night start exists on 2026-10-25
the owner changes the phone time zone to UTC
the computed interval is 2026-10-25 00:30 to 2026-10-25 01:30 in UTC
the computed duration is 60 elapsed minutes
no second Night start exists at 01:30 on 2026-10-25 in UTC

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S38 Automatic midnight overlap is one occurrence

steps.text: <view> displays the period containing 2027-01-15
the phone time zone is UTC
the owner creates Night with + at <start_time> on 2027-01-15 without a description
the computed interval is 2027-01-15 <start_time> to <end_date> <end_time> in UTC
Night is represented on 2027-01-15
its representation on 2027-01-16 is <next_day_presence>
opening any visible fragment identifies the same start 2027-01-15 <start_time>
the owner deletes Night once from its starting date and confirms
Night is absent from both 2027-01-15 and 2027-01-16
